module_summary: Passive AXI4 performance monitor: snoops all five AXI channels and, while triggered via AXI-lite control, accumulates beat, burst, byte, stall, lag and outstanding-burst counters read back over AXI-lite.

anchors.name: triggered
anchors.why: Run/stop state set on start when bus idle; enables every statistics counter.

anchors.name: clear_request
anchors.why: Pending clear request; resets all counters and trigger state.

anchors.name: start_request
anchors.why: Software start command latched from control register, applied when bus idle.

anchors.name: stop_request
anchors.why: Software stop command clearing triggered at bus idle.

anchors.name: idle_bus
anchors.why: No outstanding AXI transactions; gates start/stop/clear application.

anchors.name: active_time
anchors.why: Cycle counter while triggered with overflow bit; total measurement time.

anchors.name: perf_err
anchors.why: Sticky error when outstanding counters overflow; reported in control word.

anchors.name: wr_aw_err
anchors.why: Write-address outstanding counter overflow; freezes counter, sets perf_err.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Snooped write-address valid; drives write burst and byte statistics.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWREADY
anchors.why: Snooped write-address ready for burst counting and stall bins.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: Snooped write-data valid; drives beat counts and stall bins.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WREADY
anchors.why: Snooped write-data ready.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WLAST
anchors.why: Snooped last write beat; ends write bursts in counters.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WSTRB
anchors.why: Snooped write strobes counted into written byte totals.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWLEN
anchors.why: Snooped burst length for max-burst and byte counts.

anchors.name: M_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Snooped write response valid; retires outstanding write bursts.

anchors.name: M_AXI_BREADY
anchors.why: Snooped write response ready.

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Snooped read-address valid; drives read burst and byte statistics.

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARREADY
anchors.why: Snooped read-address ready for byte counts and AR stalls.

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARLEN
anchors.why: Snooped read burst length for max-burst and byte counts.

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARID
anchors.why: Snooped read ID indexing per-ID outstanding counters.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Snooped read-data valid; drives read beat, stall and lag bins.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RREADY
anchors.why: Snooped read-data ready.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RLAST
anchors.why: Snooped last read beat closing a read burst.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RID
anchors.why: Snooped read response ID for per-ID in-flight tracking.

anchors.name: axil_write_ready
anchors.why: AXI-lite write strobe updating start/stop/clear requests.

anchors.name: awskd_addr
anchors.why: AXI-lite write register index; 0x1f selects control word.

anchors.name: wskd_data
anchors.why: AXI-lite write data with start/clear bits.

anchors.name: arskd_addr
anchors.why: Read register address selecting which counter is returned.

anchors.name: S_AXIL_RDATA
anchors.why: AXI-lite readback of selected performance counter.

anchors.name: S_AXIL_RVALID
anchors.why: AXI-lite read response valid.

anchors.name: S_AXIL_BVALID
anchors.why: AXI-lite write response valid.

anchors.name: axil_read_ready
anchors.why: Accepts AXI-lite read address and sets read valid.

anchors.name: wr_awburst_count
anchors.why: Counts accepted write address bursts.

anchors.name: wr_beat_count
anchors.why: Counts accepted write data beats.

anchors.name: wr_aw_byte_count
anchors.why: Accumulates requested write bytes from AWLEN and AWSIZE.

anchors.name: wr_w_byte_count
anchors.why: Accumulates written bytes from active strobes.

anchors.name: wstrb_count
anchors.why: Popcount of WSTRB added to written byte count.

anchors.name: wr_max_burst_size
anchors.why: Maximum observed AWLEN.

anchors.name: wr_aw_outstanding
anchors.why: Write bursts addressed but not yet responded; feeds idle detection.

anchors.name: wr_w_outstanding
anchors.why: Write data bursts completed awaiting B response.

anchors.name: wr_aw_zero_outstanding
anchors.why: No outstanding write addresses; selects orthogonal write stall bin.

anchors.name: wr_w_zero_outstanding
anchors.why: No outstanding write data bursts; selects write bin.

anchors.name: wr_in_progress
anchors.why: Write data burst in progress between first WVALID and WLAST.

anchors.name: wr_max_outstanding
anchors.why: Maximum outstanding write bursts observed.

anchors.name: wr_idle_cycles
anchors.why: Representative orthogonal write-channel bin counter (idle cycles).

anchors.name: wr_bias
anchors.why: Signed address-before-data versus data-before-address cycle count.

anchors.name: rd_burst_count
anchors.why: Counts completed read bursts (RLAST).

anchors.name: rd_beat_count
anchors.why: Counts accepted read data beats.

anchors.name: rd_byte_count
anchors.why: Accumulates requested read bytes from ARLEN and ARSIZE.

anchors.name: rd_max_burst_size
anchors.why: Maximum observed ARLEN.

anchors.name: rd_outstanding_bursts
anchors.why: Read bursts requested but not completed; feeds idle detection.

anchors.name: rd_outstanding_bursts_id
anchors.why: Per-ID outstanding read burst counter array.

anchors.name: rd_nonzero_outstanding_id
anchors.why: Per-ID outstanding flags selecting read lag bin and first-request detect.

anchors.name: rd_bursts_in_flight
anchors.why: Per-ID read bursts mid-response; selects slow-link bin.

anchors.name: rd_responding
anchors.why: Number of IDs concurrently responding, for max responding stat.

anchors.name: rd_idle_cycles
anchors.why: Representative orthogonal read-channel bin counter (idle cycles).

anchors.name: rd_first
anchors.why: Waiting for first read response from idle bus; enables first-lag count.

anchors.name: rd_first_lag
anchors.why: Cycles of first-response read latency.

groups.name: Measurement controller
groups.description: Start/stop/clear sequencing at bus idle, active-time counter and error tracking.

groups.name: AXI-lite register interface
groups.description: Skidbuffered AXI-lite control writes and counter readback mux.

groups.name: AXI bus snoop
groups.description: Monitored AXI4 channel handshakes and burst attributes feeding statistics.

groups.name: Write statistics
groups.description: Write channel beat, burst, byte, outstanding and orthogonal stall/lag counters.

groups.name: Read statistics
groups.description: Read channel beat, burst, byte, per-ID outstanding and orthogonal lag counters.
